def: straightforward, i.e. (figuratively), equitable, correct, or (abstractly), integrity

occurrences.text: And Absalom said unto him, See, thy matters are good and right; but there is no man deputed of the king to hear thee.
They are all plain to him that understandeth, and right to them that find knowledge.
Every man shall kiss his lips that giveth a right answer.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
